grammar.numbers: a brass weight carrying the number drops onto a mini pan that swings down on a chain (the big scale dims behind it), counting up (years and dates as said); a number said while the stage is taken rides as a small chip with a tiny balance icon, top-left
grammar.comparisons: the balance scale: card 1's value lands on the left pan, card 2's on the right, each a coin stack as tall as its value (only when both parse in the same unit, else equal); the beam tips towards the heavier side by an angle proportional to the difference (spring, capped at 14°), chains swing, dust puffs; the reel's own difference (the question), or one computed from two clean values in one unit, hangs as a gold tag from the heavier pan
grammar.steps: numbered brass weight discs stacked top-down in spoken order, each dropping in as it is said with its text on a dark plaque (the scale dims behind them)
grammar.eligibility: classic verdict cue ✓/✗ (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up; the scale dims under it)
grammar.change: both pans hold `from` (level, the right one as a see-through ghost stack with SAU ?), at swapAtMs `to` drops onto the right pan and the beam re-tips by the proportional angle; the computed difference hangs from the heavier pan only when both values parse in the same unit
grammar.trend: classic line graph panel (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up; the scale dims under it)
grammar.lenders: the bank's logo tile on white drops onto the mini pan, neutral label; a small logo chip top-left when the stage is taken
grammar.captionPosition: on the dark marble floor strip under the scale, English line at the bottom of the strip

skinAxes.cover: the scale on the marble floor, a coin stack landing on each pan and the beam settling level, logo tile on white top-right, title on the floor strip
skinAxes.captions: white words on the dark marble, keywords gold, the word being said lifts with a warm glow
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics: no footage, no presenter; the brass balance scale is the hero and holds the centre
skinAxes.transitions: weights fall and land, the beam rings to its new tilt, the empty scale sways gently between beats; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: soft navy room with a pool of blue light, subtle marble veins on the floor, brass gradients on beam, pillar, chains and coins, pointer and tick arc on the pillar
skinAxes.sound: voice + a clack on each weight landing, a whip on each change swap, stat ding, chapter whoosh, point clicks
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
